name: SAPONARIA OFFICINALIS
key_symptoms: Difficult swallowing. Nausea, heartburn; full feeling not relieved by eructation.

Stitching pain, supraorbital; worse, left side, evening, motion. Throbbing over orbits. Congestions to head; tired feeling in nape. Coryza. Sensation of drunkenness with constant endeavor to go left-wards. Left-sided trigeminal neuralgia, especially supraorbital. Stopped up feeling in nose, also itching and sneezing.
Impulse weak; pulse less frequent. Palpitation with anxiety.
